id: title:Gilbert09:keep quota exhaustion out of error tracking

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error recovery capability to Google Ads warehouse ingestion, allowing Temporal activity retry to recover from temporary quota exhaustion rather than permanently failing the import job.
review.reason: Adds a whitelist of transient, recoverable errors and corresponding tests. This establishes a bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation and shared state dependencies are not present in this chunk, so the tier is assigned based on the established contract and tests rather than the complete execution path.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the retryable error handling, the configuration, or the actual Temporal activity execution. It only shows the addition of a new method and its corresponding tests. While the tests assert that a specific error message is retryable, the actual behavior relies on an external dependency (`google_ads.py`) and a shared state or global set

observations.behavior: Adds a new method `get_retryable_errors` to the Google Ads source class, returning a set containing the string 'Resource has been exhausted (e.g. check quota)'. This establishes a whitelist of errors considered transient and recoverable by Temporal's activity retry mechanism.
observations.code_quote: return {"Resource has been exhausted (e.g. check quota)"}
observations.posthog_connection: This change distinguishes between transient, recoverable quota exhaustion and permanent authentication failures. By excluding the quota error from the list of non-retryable errors, the system allows Temporal's activity retry to recover from temporary rate limits rather than permanently failing the import job. This prevents false-positive failure tracking for recoverable transient G

observations.behavior: Adds a test class and two parametrized tests to verify that the `get_retryable_errors` method correctly identifies quota exhaustion as retryable and explicitly excludes message size limits.
observations.code_quote: assert any(pattern in error_msg for pattern in self.retryable)
observations.posthog_connection: This test provides a regression guard against accidentally including permanent or non-retryable errors in the whitelist. It ensures that the implementation correctly distinguishes between a recoverable quota window and a deterministic client-side message size limit, preserving the integrity of the retry recovery path.
